'''Targob Tunall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who became famous for only accepting contracts for delivering food, medicine, and propaganda [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]] to [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] ruled by tyrants and madmen. He was rumored to never accept [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his services, preferring to to steal his profits from the enemy governments.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
